reviews.title: Gigastone Rugged NAS SSD 1TB SSD drive
reviews.comment: Gigastone Rugged NAS SSD 1TB SSD hard drive is probably the best deal for a 1 TB SSD hard drive. It haves NAS network attached storage features but no software was included ( windows based features) but overall it’s a great deal and a must have for an upgraded or to add to your existing setup
reviews.author: Sirslayer

reviews.title: I'm impressed
reviews.comment: I've used various SATA SSD cards from multiple brands. Honestly 8 have found nothing better using a Samsung, WD, or even this Gigastone. It's budget friendly, end it chugs. I've put them in laptops to replace HDD and PS4 gaming consoles. If you're reading around, or skeptical, I wouldn't worry to much.
